items.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And it reminds me of the Ruth Brown story. She had a band, they had good cars, and the state troopers just couldn’t understand it, why she would have a good car like that. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: about 11:30, 11:35, and within about three minutes, five minutes, someone knocked on my windshield. And I looked to my left, it was a policeman. He said, “I’m just getting a response from one of the stores in this area” it was like a little mall, “that you’ve been sitting here for a few minutes. Could I ask why?” I said, “Well it’s really none of your business.” He says, “Well I want to see your driver’s license and registration.” So I had a couple of choices. Because we always have a choice. I could make a big…
And it reminds me of the Ruth Brown story. She had a band, they had good cars, and the state troopers just couldn’t understand it, why she would have a good car like that.
